card.title: Outdo the Effort
card.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You brought soup? I'll cook your dinners all week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then when I'm better, I'll fill yours twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll bring them back full, with a bigger freezer. That should put me ahead.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 already-filled freezer causes A3 doubled repayment; B4 small capacity and tubs request cause A5 appliance escalation.

relationship.evidence: B2 cares for an ill friend and B4 tries to reduce the burden to returning containers.

heightening.evidence: B4 limit meant to stop escalation becomes A5 the object of an even larger favor that explicitly restores the lead.

specificity.evidence: A1 illness food help and B2 stocked freezer establish an asymmetry of care A contests.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 bigger freezer solves B4 actual constraint in a disproportionate but responsive way.
